name: Ape
printing: Revised v3.5 System Reference Document, original RTF archive
operationalEvidence: The table gives the ordinary Ape single claw attack and the two-claw and bite full attack. The Combat paragraph supplies the Climb modifier and take-10 exception.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description follows the reused portrait. Size details follow the original SRD prose where given.
habitatEvidence: Environment line in the APE table gives warm forests.

name: Crocodile
printing: Revised v3.5 System Reference Document, original RTF archive
operationalEvidence: The ordinary Crocodile table and Combat prose supply the two attack options, bite-triggered grab, hold-breath multiplier, and conditional skill bonuses. The general Improved Grab entry provides the default size limit and grapple options.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description follows the reused portrait. Size details follow the original SRD prose where given.
habitatEvidence: Environment line in the CROCODILE table gives warm marshes.

name: Dire Weasel
printing: Revised v3.5 System Reference Document, original RTF archive
operationalEvidence: The Combat text gives the trigger, AC loss, pin to remove the attached weasel by grapple, and Constitution damage per round.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description follows the reused portrait. Size details follow the original SRD prose where given.
habitatEvidence: Environment line in the DIRE WEASEL table gives temperate hills.
sourceDiscrepancies: The combat description mentions clawing. Both attack rows give only Bite, which is the attack used here.

name: Huge Shark
printing: Revised v3.5 System Reference Document, original RTF archive
operationalEvidence: The third column under SHARK supplies this record. The shared Combat prose sets the underwater Blindsense, Keen Scent and Swim rules. Animal and Aquatic traits supplement the table. This is the ordinary shark table.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description follows the reused portrait. Size details follow the original SRD prose where given.
habitatEvidence: Environment line in the SHARK, Shark, Huge column table gives cold aquatic.
sourceDiscrepancies: The original Huge column prints Will +4 and lists Iron Will. Applying the feat to that save would give +6, which appears on d20srd.org. This record retains the original +4.
